title: Pegasus and the Rules on Surveillance
goal: I can describe the Pegasus affair, zero-day vulnerabilities and lawful interception.
I can state what a law or a court requires with *előír*, *megkövetel* and *kötelezettséget ró*.
I can report what a court or a rights group has said about surveillance, naming who said it.
